summary: Vodafone Group filed a Form 6-K on 6 October 2026 attaching a UK TR-1 major holdings notification under DTR 5.8.12R(1). Societe Generale disclosed that its aggregate holding crossed above 9% on 2 October 2026, reaching 9.010091% of voting rights, comprising 8.990935% direct shares (2,082,952,851 votes) and 0.019156% via cash-settled derivatives, versus 8.995965% previously. No board recommendation or advisor is named, no price, stake target or transaction terms are stated, and no offer, review or corporate action is announced; this is a routine index of shareholding disclosure.
